items: A new creature, the rhino, with its own area, the savannah: a grey hulk with a great horn on its nose that lowers its head and charges. Its legend has a colossal horn and a hide in heavy armour folds, and sleeps sunk in the red earth like a boulder; its gift is Rhino's Charge (much faster on the ground, slower to get going). It lives on a later island, out to the south
